text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...This is...—
The slant of the sun, the ambient sound...
And above all, you, standing right before my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The conclusion drawn from this is—
Don't tell me...!
choice_data_list: You're past training time, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To think I brushed against the bough of Hypnos...
I despise my own inadequacy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed genuinely remorseful,
so I let her off with just a warning for the day.
